<b>Queen's Egg</b> is a [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, acquired from [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]] after obtaining a [[Silkeater]] from [[Styx]]. It is not available during {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]. 
__NOTOC__

== Delivery Item ==
[[File:Queen's_Egg.png|link=Queen's Egg|left|thumb|100x100px]]
The [[Queen's Egg]] has a total of 4 hit points. It takes 1 damage for every Mask of damage Hornet takes, and also when Hornet makes a heavy landing, hits a ceiling while using [[Silk Soar]], or runs into a wall while using [[Swift Step]]. Travelling with the [[Bellways]], [[Ventrica]], [[Flea Caravan]] or using the [[Beastling Call]] immediately destroys it.
{{Clear}}

== Wish ==
[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is given a Queen's Egg by Tipp & Pill to carefully deliver to Styx in [[Sinner's Road]]. Once the wish is completed, it cannot be accepted again.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Tipp & Pill 01.png!Tipp & Pill's location in Bellhart
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Styx.png!Styx's location in Sinner's Road
}}

== Possible Routes ==
The most optimal route goes through [[Greymoor]] and an unlocked shortcut to end up at Styx. The shortcut needs to be unlocked by breaking a wall on the Greymoor side.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Queen's Egg (Wish) 01.png!Route through Greymoor
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Silkeater.png|link=Silkeater|left|thumb|100x100px]]

By turning in the egg to Styx, he expands his nest, allowing for the generation of up to 2 [[Silkeater]]s at a time instead of 1. He also rewards {{R|260}} if in [[Act 1]] or [[Act 2|2]] or {{R|290}} in [[Act 3]].

{{Clear}}
